news.title: Nvidia preparing to oust CEO Jensen Huang: WSJ
news.summary: Nvidia’s board could meet as soon as today to decide Jensen Huang’s future, WSJ reports.

news.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
news.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

news.title: SEC enters fight over who regulates perpetual derivatives on stocks in the US
news.summary: The SEC is stepping into the brewing fight over whether its sister agency should have approved perpetual derivatives on individual stocks.

news.title: Uncalled US House races could send more crypto allies to Congress
news.summary: The remaining races feature pro-crypto candidates and others without a stated position, giving advocacy groups what they see as “an opportunity” for outreach.

news.title: Nomura explores sale of crypto unit Laser Digital: Bloomberg
news.summary: The potential sale of Laser Digital follows a fourth straight quarterly loss for Nomura’s European operations.

news.title: US data center restrictions could give Bitcoin miners an edge in AI, though challenges remain
news.summary: As US voters push back against new data centers, Bitcoin miners already expanding into AI could benefit from their existing facilities.

news.title: DogeOS ‘very, very close’ to launching DeFi features, app layer for Dogecoin: CEO
news.summary: DogeOS aims to give DOGE holders more ways to use the token through games, apps and financial services.

news.title: Sen. Warren, Merkley raise ethics concerns over Trump aide’s prediction market bets
news.summary: Sen. Warren is demanding answers from the White House after its teleprompter operator was accused of using advance information to bet.

news.title: OKXICE moves ahead with tokenized stocks as blue chips push back
news.summary: The Nov. 23 debut puts a new SEC exemption to the test as Nasdaq pursues its own tokenized stock plans after warning that trading across platforms could fragment liquidity.

news.title: Stablecoin supply drops $14.2 billion in largest contraction since 2022 bear market
news.summary: USDT and USDC supply fell nearly $11 billion over the past month, while gold-backed tokens held steady.

news.title: Apex Group joins Hedera Council to explore tokenization and settlement
news.summary: Apex Group, overseeing $3.5 trillion in assets, joins the Hedera Council and will explore Hedera for tokenization, compliance and settlement.

news.title: Pyth Network adds NYSE stock and ETF data to its marketplace
news.summary: Pyth Network has added real-time stock and ETF data from the New York Stock Exchange to its data marketplace.

news.title: Bitcoin hovers near $74K as stocks rise despite US bond yield rebound
news.summary: Bitcoin traded in a narrow range as investors bought the dip in tech stocks and US bond yields climbed on high CPI inflation data.

news.title: StoneX sees 111% upside for Securitize shares as tokenization revenue rebounds
news.summary: StoneX maintained its Buy rating on Securitize, citing tokenized equities, fund demand, and structured credit as growth drivers.

news.title: Crypto Long & Short: The GENIUS Act’s guarantees don’t cover DeFi lending
news.summary: Institutions weighing DeFi lending tend to ask which markets are safest. Mike Hathaway and Joseph Quintilian of Ajna argue the better question is who can change a loan’s terms after the money is lent, and why a fully backed stablecoin offers no protection against a token vote or a faulty price feed.

news.title: Bitcoin ‘ripe for a squeeze’ as options traders raise odds of sub-$70,000 Christmas
news.summary: Bitcoin trades below $74,000 on Wednesday after five weekly losses, with Derive pricing 31% odds of a sub-$70,000 Christmas.

news.title: Deutsche Bank launches crypto custody for companies and institutions
news.summary: Clients can store and transfer Bitcoin, Ether and select stablecoins through the bank, which manages their wallets and private keys.

news.title: Nomura’s Laser Digital helps launch Saudi SME credit vault targeting $100 million on BNB Chain
news.summary: Nomura's Laser Digital is advising ZIG Finance on a tokenized Saudi SME private credit vault targeting a $100 million raise on BNB Chain.

news.title: Paraguay bank collapse shows stablecoins can offer a lifeline... of sorts
news.summary: Ueno’s collapse exposed the fragility of digital banking in Paraguay, as customers scrambled for access to their money and stablecoins offered a lifeline.

news.title: Bitcoin Covenants Part 5: MATT and OP_CHECKCONTRACTVERIFY — How Bitcoin could carry state across transactions
news.summary: OP_CCV embeds contract state directly into Taproot output keys and enforces valid state transitions onchain. This makes it possible to achieve stateful contracts and compact fraud proofs.

news.title: CoreWeave stock jumps 15% premarket after Q3 revenue beats estimates
news.summary: CoreWeave’s third-quarter revenue rose 168% to $3.66 billion, beating analyst estimates by 3.4%. Its revenue backlog reached $132.5 billion.

news.title: OKXICE sets Nov. 23 launch for tokenized securities venue under SEC innovation exemption
news.summary: OKXICC, plans to launch its tokenized securities venue at the end of the month, the joint venture announced on Wednesday.

news.title: OKXICE to debut tokenized stock trading with Strategy, Coinbase, Circle this month
news.summary: After initial issuer pushback, the blockchain venue is set to start trading on Nov. 23 and said will list over 70 assets, including Strategy’s common and preferred shares and 59 of Direxion's ETFs.

news.title: Meet Spiko, the largest tokenized fund in the world you’ve probably never heard about
news.summary: The firm’s flagship Spiko Amundi Overnight Swap Fund (SAFO) held $2.39 billion in assets under management as of late last month.

news.title: Bitcoin Core discloses three patched security flaws, including high-severity mining bug
news.summary: Bitcoin Core disclosed three previously patched security vulnerabilities, including a high-severity bug affecting block template creation.

news.title: Crypto fraudster jailed for eight years over $2.7 million theft plot directed from prison

news.title: FSB urgest Turkey to tighten crypto oversight, set stablecoin rules
news.summary: The Financial Stability Board cited progress on crypto licensing and urged stronger enforcement and cooperation with foreign regulators.

news.title: Zcash falls below $1,000 for first time since September

news.summary: Deutsche Bank launched its digital asset custody service and signed an agreement covering tokenized funds, crypto ETCs, and stablecoins.

news.title: Bitcoin sits out stock rebound as ETF outflows extend to fourth day
news.summary: Bitcoin held steady near $74,000 as Tuesday's hot inflation figure lifted the odds on a U.S. interest-rate increase to around 90%. ETF outflows extended to a fourth day and liquidations jumped.

news.title: Kraken parent adds over 200 tokenized UK and EU stocks to xStocks
news.summary: The expansion adds more than 200 tokenized UK and EU equities, including all 40 companies in Germany’s DAX index, as xStocks plans further expansion into Hong Kong.

news.title: Bitcoin short-term holders send 47K BTC to exchanges at a loss
news.summary: Bitcoin fell to an 11-week low of $72,670 after slipping below short-term holders’ average cost basis of about $75,700, according to CryptoQuant.

news.title: Crosschain protocol Across restores systems after domain hijack
news.summary: Attackers gained control of Across's official domain through a social engineering attack on its domain registrar, Namecheap.

news.title: Kraken parent Payward adds 200 tokenized UK and European equities to xStocks offering
news.summary: Kraken parent Payward added more than 200 UK and European equities to xStocks, taking its tokenized offering past 1,500 assets.

news.title: Kraken's xStocks adds 200 UK and EU shares as its assets top $1.1 billion
news.summary: Payward says xStocks holds over $1.1 billion. Each token is backed by a share but gives no ownership of the underlying company.

news.title: Bitcoin stuck under $74,000 as CoreWeave earnings revive AI outlook, Anthropic said to raise IPO valuation
news.summary: CoreWeave’s revenue surge lifted AI infrastructure stocks and Nasdaq futures, while bitcoin was little changed over 24 hours.

news.title: Bitget Wallet reports sevenfold jump in crypto phishing risk alerts
news.summary: The wallet flagged about 37,000 signing requests a week for phishing in Q3 and said better monitoring likely contributed to the increase.

news.title: Bitmine posts $6.3B net loss for fiscal 2026 as Ether prices slide
news.summary: Bitmine booked $6.2 billion in unrealized losses on digital assets. It held 6.07 million ETH on Sunday, or 4.97% of Ether’s supply.

news.title: New York federal judge denies Novig’s injunction bid, rules its sports event contracts are not swaps
news.summary: A federal judge ruled New York can enforce gambling laws against Novig after finding its sports contracts are not swaps.

news.title: ECB warns legislative delays could postpone digital euro launch

news.title: Stock ETF buyers pounce on dip as Bitcoin funds bleed $1.6 billion
news.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs have lost $1.6 billion in November, while stock funds attracted billions of dollars from investors buying the dip.

news.title: SEC enforcement actions fall 24%, crypto cases in spotlight
news.summary: The SEC filed 348 actions in fiscal 2026, down from 456 a year earlier. Cases included alleged Bitcoin mining fraud and an FTX audit settlement.

news.title: Bitmine reports $6.3 billion net loss in latest fiscal year, driven by 44% ether decline
news.summary: According to its SEC filing, nearly $6.23 billion of the net losses came from unrealized fair value losses on digital asset holdings.

news.title: Initia confirms second exploit in 3 weeks, $3.27M stolen in latest attack
news.summary: Initia said an attacker exploited compromised cloud credentials to move $3.27 million in crypto assets, with about $2.16 million remaining frozen on its halted network.

news.title: Across Protocol restores website after hackers hijack domain
news.summary: The cross-chain bridge said a social engineering attack targeting domain registrar Namecheap allowed hackers to redirect users to a phishing site.

news.title: Tron Inc reports 22% rise in Q3 net income as unrealized staking revenue grows
news.summary: The company reported Q3 2026 net income of $14.9 million, up 22% year-over-year, with a nine-month net income of $39.4 million, up 203%.

news.title: Crypto ally Tom Emmer elected House GOP minority whip

news.title: LNbits rushes emergency patch after reported Bitcoin wallet thefts
news.summary: The project warned that installations running older versions were vulnerable and urged operators to replace potentially exposed credentials even after upgrading.

news.title: Warren: What is White House doing to prevent a repeat of teleprompter's Trump bets?
news.summary: U.S. Senator Elizabeth Warren argued the administration is not doing enough about staff insider trading, questioning whether CFTC enforcement action was sufficient.

news.summary: Stacey Cunningham, who recently joined digital asset platform Bullish as President, sees the company’s planned Equiniti acquisition and focus on stock issuers as key to its tokenization ambitions.

news.title: Goldman Sachs, Citi among banks said to commit $270 million to stablecoin venture
news.summary: The venture, known as Project Faro, plans to issue a dollar-denominated stablecoin and is expected to be incorporated in the U.S.

news.title: Crypto is now teamed up with U.S. government in two legal battles over perps
news.summary: Twice now, crypto firms have found themselves on the side of the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission in holding that perpetual futures aren't swaps.

news.title: Plume affiliate lands broker-dealer license to bring real U.S. assets onchain
news.summary: Kimber Digital Securities secured SEC and Finra approvals, a regulatory milestone paving the way for the delivery of legally binding claims, dividends, and yield-bearing products directly to self-custodial wallets and stablecoin applications in the U.S.

news.title: Will stablecoins survive once the banks catch up?
news.summary: As crypto firms and banks converge, it is fair to ask what lasting advantage stablecoins have, argues Alessandro Hatami, founder of Pacemakers and former COO of Digital Banking at Lloyds Banking Group.

news.title: U.S. CPI rose stronger than expected 0.4% in October; core rate rose 0.3%
news.summary: A December rate hike appears completely assured, with Fed Governor Chris Waller suggesting even a 50-basis-point move could be appropriate.

news.title: Ripple Prime head Marc Asch to step down, Noel Kimmel named successor

news.summary: Bots spotted a wallet from Ethereum’s 2015 launch the moment it stirred and planted lookalike addresses in its history, but the owner sent the money to the right place anyway.

news.title: Bitcoin miner MARA sold 13,597 BTC for $1.1 billion in six weeks, plans to sell more
news.summary: MARA paid off every loan backed by its bitcoin and says the rest of its coins can fund AI datacenters.

news.summary: The XRP Ledger Foundation’s design lets owners add a quantum-resistant key and switch off the old one, part of a roadmap that puts the network on track for a full transition by 2028.
